summary: Tested Founder Page Invite System - single-use invites, revocation, verification, and admin management. Found and fixed a critical bug: FounderInvitesTab was using wrong localStorage key ('token' instead of 'carryon_token'). All features now working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: FounderInvitesTab.js was using localStorage.getItem('token') but app stores token as 'carryon_token' - changed all 3 occurrences
Public About page at /about loads correctly with improved backgrounds (flag image visible)
Homepage header 'About' link correctly navigates to /about
Founder page /founder-about/:token with invalid token shows 'Access Restricted' with appropriate message
Founder page with valid token renders iframe content (founder-story.html - 11MB file with embedded images)
Single-use invite behavior works: first use succeeds, second use shows 'already_used' message
Revoked invites correctly show 'revoked' message on the Founder page
Admin panel Invites tab loads with stats (Total/Active/Used), create form, and invite list
Create invite from admin panel works - shows success toast and adds to list
Copy invite link functionality works (copies to clipboard)
Revoke invite works - shows success toast and updates badge to 'Revoked'
All backend endpoints properly require admin authentication (401/403 for unauthorized)
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test invites with TEST_ prefix for testing purposes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Founder Page Invite System fully tested and working. The FounderInvitesTab component was fixed to use correct localStorage key 'carryon_token'. All invite CRUD operations work: create, list, verify, use (single-use), revoke. The founder-story.html is an 11MB file with embedded base64 images that takes a few seconds to load in the iframe.

backend.POST /api/founder/invites (create): PASS - creates invite with token, note, timestamps
backend.POST /api/founder/invites (no note): PASS - creates invite with empty note

frontend.About page loads at /about: PASS - hero text, mission, vision, values visible
frontend.About page backgrounds: PASS - flag image visible with improved styling
frontend.Founder page invalid token: PASS - shows Access Restricted with 'not valid' message
frontend.Founder page valid token: PASS - renders iframe with founder story content
frontend.Admin Invites tab content: PASS - stats cards, create form, invite list visible
frontend.Create invite from admin: PASS - success toast, invite appears in list
frontend.Revoke invite from admin: PASS - success toast, badge changes to Revoked

bug_fixed.issue: Component was using localStorage.getItem('token') but the app stores auth token as 'carryon_token'
bug_fixed.fix: Changed all 3 occurrences of localStorage.getItem('token') to localStorage.getItem('carryon_token')
